import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Get columns for predictions
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Preprocess comments - remove whitespace-only strings and very short texts
cleaned_text = [comment.strip() for comment in train_df["comment_text"]] + [
    comment.strip() for comment in test_df["comment_text"]
]
cleaned_text = [t if len(t) > 1 else "" for t in cleaned_text]

# Split training data for validation
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    cleaned_text,
    train_df[target_cols],
    stratify=train_df["toxic"],
    random_state=42,
    test_size=0.2,
    shuffle=True,
)

# Vectorize text with refined parameters
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=1)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Initialize best model scores
best_val_auc_list = []

for col_idx, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    # Train XGBoost classifier with optimized hyperparameters
    clf = XGBClassifier(
        use_label_encoder=False,
        eval_metric="logloss",
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        n_estimators=500,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=1.0,
        random_state=42,
        scale_pos_weight=0.1,
        verbose=0,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train[col].astype(int))

    # Predict probabilities on hold-out validation set
    val_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    val_roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[col].astype(int), val_pred_proba)
    best_val_auc_list.append(val_roc_auc)
    print(f"Column {col}: Validation ROC AUC = {val_roc_auc:.4f}")

# Final evaluation metric
final_validation_auc = np.mean(best_val_auc_list)
print(f"\nFinal Column-wise ROC AUC: {final_validation_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
predictions = {}
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    preds = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    predictions[col] = preds.astype("float64")

# Save predictions
if not os.path.exists("./submission"):
    os.makedirs("./submission")

sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
final_preds = sample_submission[["id"]].copy()
for col in target_cols:
    final_preds[f"{col}"] = predictions[col]

final_preds.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print final metric for grading reference
print(f"\nColumn-wise ROC AUC for Grading: {final_validation_auc:.4f}")
